newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas sees no front month trade in thin marke.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas sees no front month trade in thin marke.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw a disappointing 95 lots traded in only nine deals on Friday, with no trade at all done on the new front month, April.
Most futures prices were marginally up, but the volumes were too thin to make the movements significant.

"There's hardly been a deal done in gas today, even on the OTC market," said a futures broker. The only area of activity on the OTC market was in the very prompt period, he added. This is no longer reflected on the futures market now that the front month, March, rolled on Thursday.
"Bids and offers are too far apart. The IPE has performed as well as the OTC," the broker said, adding that it was a "disappointing day all round."

The IPE confirmed that a total of 345 lots traded in March, representing 345,000 therms a day, will go to physical delivery. The delivery procedure starts on Saturday, and several players will be watching the procedure's performance with interest as a guide to how it may work in the future.
